app.name: TUJYANE
app.tagline: Share the ride, share the cost.
app.slogan: Share the ride. Split the cost.

auth.welcomeSub: You can browse and search rides without an account. Sign in to post a journey or book a seat.
auth.roleIntent: I want to use TUJYANE as

role.bothDesc: Some days I drive, some I ride

auth.termsHint: By creating an account you agree to TUJYANE's community rules.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Mix letters, numbers and symbols for a stronger password.

cookie.title: We use cookies
cookie.body: TUJYANE uses cookies to keep you signed in and to understand how the app is used. You can change your choice any time.

styleguide.title: TUJYANE design system
styleguide.subtitle: Every component in every state. Toggle themes with the icon in the header.

landing.heroValueProp: Find a seat or share yours across Rwanda. Fair, verified, and always in your own currency.
landing.browseHint: No account needed to browse — you'll only sign in when you request or post.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Pick your start and destination — we suggest fair per-seat contributions based on distance and vehicle.
how.step2Body: Send a seat request. The driver accepts, and you get a private 4-digit boarding code.
how.step3Body: On the day, show the code to the driver. They confirm it — that's your proof of boarding.

trust.title: Built on trust
trust.sub: Every safety guardrail on by default.
trust.verifiedBody: Every driver's ID, licence and vehicle papers are reviewed by a real human before their first post.
trust.codeBody: Every accepted booking gets a private 4-digit code. No code, no ride.
trust.ratingsBody: Drivers and passengers rate each other after every trip. Reputations are earned.
trust.fairBody: The system calculates a fair band per seat. Drivers never quote an unfair price.

drive.title: Turn empty seats into shared fuel money.
drive.body: Post a trip in under a minute. Accept the passengers you want, keep control of your car — and get help covering fuel.
